in.rationale: A faulty role variant defeats the toy bound and shows why the verifier mapping is necessary.

notes: This shows the role-mapping condition matters. It does not refute the theorem, whose prescribed Vera is different.

text: A verifier that always returns false even on an exact claim yields zero acceptance when Bob always challenges in the toy true_75 case.
title: Faulty verifier counterexample
